def equation(t, P, params):
    p = params
    lt = np.log(t)
    sP = np.sqrt(P)
    return (p[0] + p[1]*t + p[2]*lt + p[3]/t
            + (p[4] + p[5]*lt + p[6]/t)*sP
            + (p[7] + p[8]*t + p[9]*lt)*P)
